difficultyRationale: Tests the documented creation-time contract of the immutable Set factory methods.
explanation: The unmodifiable sets created by `Set.of` reject duplicate elements at creation time. Passing duplicates causes `IllegalArgumentException`.

options.text: It creates a set containing one element.
options.explanation: Unlike adding twice to many mutable Set implementations, `Set.of` rejects duplicate arguments instead of silently keeping one.
A Set cannot contain duplicate equal elements, and the factory does not preserve both arguments.
The `Set.of` contract specifies `IllegalArgumentException` for duplicate elements.
UnsupportedOperationException applies to mutation attempts on the created unmodifiable set, not duplicate arguments at creation time.
